sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Lisbon Tech Fringe: a guide to side events built by the whole team when the storm cancelled day two.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Brief at 10:00, own address by about 12:57; one conductor per person; 179 events; a guest-list hold.

sections.label: An alternative summit
sections.line: With day two cancelled, a spoken brief for an alternative summit site; "Yes to all of it. Go."
sections.para: Nobody was mapping the side events.

sections.label: From brief to an address
sections.line: Live before noon, at lisbontechfringe.com by about 12:57, two and a half hours after the brief.

sections.label: The whole team at once
sections.line: Built by everyone at once: each person ran a conductor, roles written down, work claimed by commit.

sections.label: 179 events, each re-read
sections.line: 179 events and 104 communities, each re-read at its source, labelled, storm moves marked.
sections.para: Sources refused or held on terms.

sections.label: The guest-list hold
sections.line: Captures showed guests' names; the lead conductor overruled a public key until they were cropped.
sections.para: An agent overruling me, in writing.

sections.label: Traced, graphed and queryable
sections.line: Elastic traces, a Neo4j graph, a live storm page and SQL in the browser; policies per agent.

sections.label: What it did not get to
sections.line: A submit form, an API index and a redirect were not done; paused on 12 November at 15:15.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Times from the site's records; counts as of 12 November; people by role.
